subject.title: Feature Request: Add cumulative history search and multi-account support

question: Should wacrawl first implement a per-account cumulative archive with explicit historical imports and track first-class profile UX separately, or should both capabilities be designed as one combined storage migration?
rationale: The current replacement archive, backup restore contract, message identity, media layout, and global path defaults all need a consistent product boundary before code can safely choose merge semantics or profile configuration.

options.title: Split cumulative history first
options.body: Design an account-scoped cumulative archive and explicit historical merge command first, while tracking named profile UX as a separate follow-up that reuses the same namespace.

options.title: Design one combined migration
options.body: Introduce profiles, account-scoped schema identity, backup configuration, media layout, and cumulative history together as one larger coordinated storage migration.

options.title: Keep manual isolation only
options.body: Retain the existing --db, --source, and --config path workflow and defer cumulative retention and named profiles.

recommendation.title: Split cumulative history first
recommendation.body: Design an account-scoped cumulative archive and explicit historical merge command first, while tracking named profile UX as a separate follow-up that reuses the same namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work by steipete established the snapshot, restore, media, and archive contracts that this decision would change.
